impact: Gas production stopped and a large fire broke out; power generation expected to fall by 2,500–2,800 MW.
summary: Shafaq News and Kurdistan24 reported that drones struck the Xormor (Khor Mor) gas field on the evening of 8 November 2026, setting the gas storage and LPG units on fire and halting production; no one was hurt. Rudaw's security source said it was launched from Xurmatû (Tuz Khurmatu), and channels linked to pro-Iran Iraqi armed groups called it a 'suicide drone'; no group claimed it.

sources.title: Shafaq News: Khor Mor gas field halts production after drone attack
Kurdistan24: Attack on Khor Mor Gas Field Halts Production, Causes Major Fire
Rudaw: Gas production halted in Khor Mor after strike hits gas storage unit
